title: Sampling Fluorspar (Fluorite) - Methods
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard lays down the procedure to be followed in collecting and preparing samples from a lot in order to determine ore sizes, moisture content and the chemical composition of fluorspar in the lot. It details the procedure for sampling the ore from stock piles, rail wagons and ships. 1.2 This standard also includes a method for reporting the quality of the bulk of the fluorspar sampled.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
